item.title: U.S. crude falls below $100 amid reports of U.S.-Iran diplomatic efforts

item.description: Ryanair's CEO Michael O'Leary told CNBC that European airlines may have "significantly higher airfares" of up to 20% next year as fuel costs rise.

item.title: Defense, healthcare, crypto and AI: How the midterm election could affect stocks
item.description: Democratic gains in Congress could bring tougher oversight of major companies and shift billions of dollars in federal spending and regulatory policy.

item.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman made an unannounced visit to South Korea over the weekend, meeting with Samsung executives and reportedly SK Group executives.

item.title: ‘Pop-up’ super PACs pour $637 million into 2026 midterm races
